name: Rotom Boy (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange handheld game console with lens eyes and a fanged grin, hugged by the glowing ghost of a Pikachu
entry: This Rotom haunts an old handheld game console. The ghost of a Pikachu it once played as glows round it.
how: Use a Retro Cartridge on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Thunder in this form.
